dialogues.jp:
「お任せでいいって言ったから、適当に買って
　きたけど……」
dialogues.en:
However, it seems like Yoriko-san is still thinking about
it, and her face is still red like the color of the sunset.
dialogues.text:
However, it seems like Yoriko-san is still thinking about
it, and her face is still red like the color of the sunset.

dialogues.jp:
夜。ベランダでの興奮は、さすがに過ぎ去って
いた。
dialogues.en:
But as for myself, I felt too hungry after the excitement
died down, and I went to a convenience store for food.
dialogues.text:
But as for myself, I felt too hungry after the excitement
died down, and I went to a convenience store for food.

dialogues.jp:
──もっとも、頼子さんはその限りでないらし
く、夕映えが焼き付いたように、まだ頬を赤く
保っている。
dialogues.en: "I hope you like them."
dialogues.text: "I hope you like them."

dialogues.jp:
興奮で追いやられていた空腹感は、我が物顔で
舞い戻り、俺をコンビニへと駆り立てた。
dialogues.en:
I put all the food I bought on the table, feeling like I'm
selling them to her.
dialogues.text:
I put all the food I bought on the table, feeling like I'm
selling them to her.

dialogues.jp: 「気に入るといいんだけど」
dialogues.en:
"......This is a super-size... kimchi gyudon with extra
soup."
dialogues.text:
"......This is a super-size... kimchi gyudon with extra
soup."

dialogues.jp:
ちょっとした行商人の気分を味わいつつ、テー
ブルに並べていく。
dialogues.en:
"Oh, this is for me. I mean if you want it, you can have it,
of course."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, this is for me. I mean if you want it, you can have it,
of course."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……超特盛り……ツユだくキムチ……牛丼？」

やんわりとした否定だが、拒絶のオーラは相当
に強かった。まあ、似合わない取り合わせでは
ある。
dialogues.en:
She softly declines my offer, but I can tell from the
atmosphere that she really doesn't want it. I understand
that, because this super-size kimchi gyudon doesn't really
sound like her.
dialogues.text:
She softly declines my offer, but I can tell from the
atmosphere that she really doesn't want it. I understand
that, because this super-size kimchi gyudon doesn't really
sound like her.

dialogues.jp: 「頼子さんにはこっちを買ってきたんだけど」
dialogues.en: "I bought these for you."
dialogues.text: "I bought these for you."

dialogues.jp: 海老ドリアと海草サラダだ。
dialogues.en:
I bought a white-sauced rice bowl with shrimps and a
seaweeds salad.
dialogues.text:
I bought a white-sauced rice bowl with shrimps and a
seaweeds salad.

dialogues.jp: 「どうかな？」
dialogues.en: "Do you like them?"
dialogues.text: "Do you like them?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、はい、その……いいと、思います」
dialogues.en: "Ah, yes, I...... I think I do."
dialogues.text: "Ah, yes, I...... I think I do."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「なら良かった。じゃ、早速温めますか」
dialogues.en: "Good. Then let's microwave them."
dialogues.text: "Good. Then let's microwave them."

dialogues.jp: ドリアと牛丼を持ち、台所へと向かう。
dialogues.en:
I pick up my gyudon and her white-sauced rice bowl and go to
the kitchen.
dialogues.text:
I pick up my gyudon and her white-sauced rice bowl and go to
the kitchen.

dialogues.jp: ふと気になり、俺は振り返った。
dialogues.en: But I turn around and ask her,
dialogues.text: But I turn around and ask her,

dialogues.jp: 「温めるの、ぬるめにしようか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you want it hot or warm?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want it hot or warm?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「え？　どうしてですか……？」
dialogues.en: "What? Why......?"
dialogues.text: "What? Why......?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「猫舌じゃない？」
dialogues.en: "I thought you have a cat tongue."
dialogues.text: "I thought you have a cat tongue."

dialogues.jp:
だが予想に反して首を振ったので、俺は普通に
温める事にした。
dialogues.en:
Contrary to my expectations, she shakes her head side to
side. So I microwave them to make them hot.
dialogues.text:
Contrary to my expectations, she shakes her head side to
side. So I microwave them to make them hot.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あふいです……」
dialogues.en: "I-It's hot......"
dialogues.text: "I-It's hot......"

dialogues.jp:
懐かしのギャグを思い出す。たしか、あれは湯
豆腐だったっけか……。
dialogues.en: I remember an old joke about hot tofu......
dialogues.text: I remember an old joke about hot tofu......

dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり猫舌だったか」
dialogues.en: "So you do have a cat tongue."
dialogues.text: "So you do have a cat tongue."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そうだったみたいです……」
dialogues.en: "I didn't know I do......"
dialogues.text: "I didn't know I do......"

dialogues.jp:
舌が痛いのか顔をしかめつつ、それでも頼子さ
んは笑みを浮かべた。
dialogues.en:
She frowns from the pain on her tongue, but she forces a
smile.
dialogues.text:
She frowns from the pain on her tongue, but she forces a
smile.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「でも……美味しいです……」
dialogues.en: "But...... this tastes good......"
dialogues.text: "But...... this tastes good......"

dialogues.jp:
スプーンにちょこっとすくい、念入りに、ふー
ふーする。
dialogues.en:
She puts a small amount of food on her spoon and carefully
blows to cool it down.
dialogues.text:
She puts a small amount of food on her spoon and carefully
blows to cool it down.

dialogues.jp:
そうして口の中に運ぶと、頼子さんの顔が嬉し
そうに｛ほころ／綻｝んだ。
dialogues.en:
As she carries the spoon to her mouth, her frown eases, and
she finally shows a natural smile.
dialogues.text:
As she carries the spoon to her mouth, her frown eases, and
she finally shows a natural smile.

dialogues.jp:
「最近のコンビニは、ほんと品揃えが良くて、
　助かるよ」
dialogues.en:
"I like convenience stores because they have a lot of
selection these days."
dialogues.text:
"I like convenience stores because they have a lot of
selection these days."

dialogues.jp:
俺も新発売の超特盛り〔略〕を口に運ぶ。品揃
えは味には関係がないらしく、マズイ。
dialogues.en:
I take a bite of the new super-size kimchi gyudon as well.
And I discover that despite the good selections, their
tastes aren't good at all. It tastes terrible.
dialogues.text:
I take a bite of the new super-size kimchi gyudon as well.
And I discover that despite the good selections, their
tastes aren't good at all. It tastes terrible.

dialogues.jp: 「というか、ツユだく過ぎ。ほら、見てくれよ」
dialogues.en:
"This says with extra soup, but it's too much soup......
Look at this."
dialogues.text:
"This says with extra soup, but it's too much soup......
Look at this."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「す、凄いですね……」
dialogues.en: "Yes, w-wow......"
dialogues.text: "Yes, w-wow......"

dialogues.jp: どう凄いのかは秘密だ。
dialogues.en: I am not sure how serious her 'wow' it was.
dialogues.text: I am not sure how serious her 'wow' it was.

dialogues.jp: 「ま、いいけどね」
dialogues.en: "Oh, well."
dialogues.text: "Oh, well."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「あの……いつも……その……。お店のご飯を
　食べているのですか……？」
dialogues.en: "Ah...... Do you...... always... eat food from stores?"
dialogues.text: "Ah...... Do you...... always... eat food from stores?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「うん？　ああ、まあ、そうだね。コンビニと
　か、店屋物とか……後、たまに食いに出たり
　とか」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah, I think so. I eat food from convenience stores and
takeaway...... and sometimes I go out to eat."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah, I think so. I eat food from convenience stores and
takeaway...... and sometimes I go out to eat."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「ともかく、自分では作らないな。炊事とかが
　まるで出来なくてさ」
dialogues.en: "I don't make dinner. I can't make anything."
dialogues.text: "I don't make dinner. I can't make anything."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、えと、それだったら……あの……」

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「その……私が……」

頼子さんから、勇気がぎゅっと絞り出された音
が聞こえたような気がした。
dialogues.en:
I think I can hear a squeezing noise from her body as she
squeezes out the courage to speak.
dialogues.text:
I think I can hear a squeezing noise from her body as she
squeezes out the courage to speak.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「私が、作りたいと……思うのですが……」
dialogues.en: "I would like to...... cook for you......"
dialogues.text: "I would like to...... cook for you......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「えっ？　いや、それは嬉しいけど……でも、
　料理なんて出来るの？」
dialogues.en:
"What? I mean, it's great if you want to. But can you really
cook?"
dialogues.text:
"What? I mean, it's great if you want to. But can you really
cook?"

dialogues.jp:
ぶしつけな問いかけになるが、今までの実績を
考えると、どうも頼りないのだ。
dialogues.en:
I know it's a rude question, but it's hard to believe that
she can cook because of what she's done so far.
dialogues.text:
I know it's a rude question, but it's hard to believe that
she can cook because of what she's done so far.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「あ、いえ。した事はまだ……ないのですが
　……」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, I don't know, because...... I haven't cooked
before......"
dialogues.text:
"Ah, I don't know, because...... I haven't cooked
before......"

dialogues.jp: そいつは……。
dialogues.en: See?
dialogues.text: See?

dialogues.jp:
世の中には、二種類の料理がある。食える料理
と、食えない料理。至ってシンプルな分類だ。
dialogues.en:
In this world, there are two kinds of food. A meal you can
eat and a meal you can't eat. It is as simple as that.
dialogues.text:
In this world, there are two kinds of food. A meal you can
eat and a meal you can't eat. It is as simple as that.

dialogues.jp:
ある種の──音夢──料理人の手にかかれば、
食材は食えない料理へと変貌を遂げてしまう。
dialogues.en:
Some cooks --like Nemu-- can change any cooking ingredients
to a meal that people can't eat.
dialogues.text:
Some cooks --like Nemu-- can change any cooking ingredients
to a meal that people can't eat.

dialogues.jp:
焼きすぎた焼き肉が炭と化すように、それは、
もはや“食い物じゃない何か”なのだ。
dialogues.en:
Just like when you cook a piece of meat and burn it till it
turns into a piece of charcoal, it's no longer food but it's
'a thing that you can't eat'.
dialogues.text:
Just like when you cook a piece of meat and burn it till it
turns into a piece of charcoal, it's no longer food but it's
'a thing that you can't eat'.

dialogues.jp:
「はは、は……。いや、でもさ、コンビニの弁
　当だって、捨てたもんじゃないだろ？　その
　ドリアだって、美味しいって言ったじゃん」
dialogues.en:
"Haha... ha...... But convenience store food isn't that bad,
you know. You just told me that your white-sauced rice bowl
tastes good."
dialogues.text:
"Haha... ha...... But convenience store food isn't that bad,
you know. You just told me that your white-sauced rice bowl
tastes good."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「で、ですけど……栄養が……。そ、それに
　……」
dialogues.en: "B-But...... they're not healthy...... A-And......"
dialogues.text: "B-But...... they're not healthy...... A-And......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「それに、私は……メイドです……」
dialogues.en: "And I am...... a maid......"
dialogues.text: "And I am...... a maid......"

dialogues.jp:
料理人の資質としては、音夢とどっちが上なん
だろうか？
dialogues.en: I wonder who is better as a cook, Nemu or her?
dialogues.text: I wonder who is better as a cook, Nemu or her?

dialogues.jp:
そんな、ドングリでさえない、言わばゴマ粒の
背比べをしつつ、俺は深くうなだれたのだった。
dialogues.en:
It's not even like a comparison of which acorn's bigger, but
it was more like a comparison of which sesame seed is
bigger. I drop my shoulders with a sigh.
dialogues.text:
It's not even like a comparison of which acorn's bigger, but
it was more like a comparison of which sesame seed is
bigger. I drop my shoulders with a sigh.

dialogues.jp:
もちろん、頼子さんがタケノコのように、すく
すく育たないとも限らないのだが……。
dialogues.en:
I can't deny there's a possibility of Yoriko-san growing up
to be a great cook, but......
dialogues.text:
I can't deny there's a possibility of Yoriko-san growing up
to be a great cook, but......

dialogues.jp:
「分かった。じゃあ、今度料理の本を買ってく
　るよ。とりあえず、まずはそれから……」
dialogues.en:
"......Okay. Then I'll get you a cooking book. Let's start
from there."
dialogues.text:
"......Okay. Then I'll get you a cooking book. Let's start
from there."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「は、はい……分かりました……」
dialogues.en: "Y-Yes...... I understand......"
dialogues.text: "Y-Yes...... I understand......"

dialogues.jp:
浮かんでいた笑顔を見て、少し救われた気分に
なった。が──。
dialogues.en: She's smiling and I feel relieved. But...
dialogues.text: She's smiling and I feel relieved. But...

dialogues.jp:
笑顔で腹は膨れない。果たして、俺の食生活は
どうなるのだろうか……？
dialogues.en:
Her smile isn't gonna fill up my stomach. What's my diet
going to be like......?
dialogues.text:
Her smile isn't gonna fill up my stomach. What's my diet
going to be like......?

dialogues.jp: ◆料理を作りたい◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
「いつも食事はどうしているのですか？」と尋
ねる頼子さんに、店屋物かコンビニ弁当だと答
えると、自分が料理を作りたいとのこと。

取り合えず、料理の本を買ってきてから、とい
う事になったが……。
dialogues.en: "Th......Thank you so much......"
dialogues.text: "Th......Thank you so much......"

dialogues.jp: 俺の食生活は一体どうなるのだろうか。
dialogues.en:
It's night-time, and the feelings of excitement we had at
the veranda have already gone.
dialogues.text:
It's night-time, and the feelings of excitement we had at
the veranda have already gone.
